A Gujarati classic steamed snack made with grated lauki, wheat and millet flour, besan, and spices that’s healthy, wholesome, and super delicious. I’ve shared the perfect measurements and all the tips to get soft, flavourful muthiyas every single time, along with a special chutney that pairs amazingly with them.
Do give this recipe a try, it’s one of those simple, homely recipes that you’ll keep coming back to. The full written recipe is mentioned below in the description. Happy Cooking!
